WELCOME_P3: Thankfully, this should only happen once and future updates will occur in the background
SETTINGS_ABOUT_P1: Saorsail ("Free" in Gaelic) is a web-based storefront for all apps that are free and/or open source. Built upon the incredible work of the F-Droid team, Saorsail uses the F-Droid public database to give you access to huge collection of public domain apps.
SETTINGS_ABOUT_P2: Saorsail has also been designed to make it super easy to install apps from the web, directly to your devices.
